item.title: [MEDIUM] Bank of Ireland warns of deepfake videos cloning presidential candidate Heather Humphreys
item.description: Bank of Ireland warned that fraudsters were cloning the image and voice of presidential candidate Heather Humphreys in fake investment videos on Meta platforms, and called for platforms to verify financial advertisers. Target: Irish consumers. IE. Verification: confirmed.
